objective: Compare one two-request GDN transaction directly with two isolated one-request transactions on identical tensors, outputs, and cache state. Determine why the R80 combined ordinary-kernel replay did not restore c2 token identity.

arms.native: Existing two-request speculative kernels versus the same kernels called once per request.
arms.r80_combined_serial: R80 multi-request ordinary one-token convolution and delta replay versus the existing one-request speculative kernels.

measurements: bitwise equality and maximum absolute difference for z and core_attn_out
bitwise equality and maximum absolute difference for every touched convolution and SSM cache row
decision: If the native c2 arm differs from isolated c1 while R80 combined serial also differs, identify which stage/state differs and implement a new per-request speculative-kernel split only after this operator evidence. If R80 is operator-exact, reject GDN arithmetic as the server-level cause and move to integration/state lifetime.
promotion_boundary: Operator diagnostic only; no throughput or quality promotion.
